% REQ: LANG-331 LANG-332 LANG-333 LANG-334 LANG-335
-module(greeter).
-export([greet/2, start/0]).
-define(GREETING, "Hello").

%% Greets Name Times times.
greet(Name, Times) when is_list(Name), Times > 0 ->
    Text = ?GREETING ++ ", " ++ Name ++ "!\n",
    lists:flatten(lists:duplicate(Times, Text));
greet(_, _) ->
    {error, 'bad args'}.

start() ->
    Pid = spawn(fun() -> loop(0) end),
    Pid ! {self(), greet("world", 2)},
    receive
        {ok, Reply} -> io:format("~s~n", [Reply])
    after 1000 ->
        timeout
    end,
    X = 16#1F + 2#1010 + 3.14,
    case X > 0 andalso true of
        true -> ok;
        false -> undefined
    end.

loop(N) -> receive _ -> loop(N + 1) end.
